_meta.doc: Sniff CoverageFrames: reasoned absence as machine-readable frames. Generated, never hand-maintained. Conforms to schema/sniff-coverage-frame.yaml plus the provenance module, and is verified against them on every build.

frames.question: Does a canine model foundation exist for this human disease gene under ClinVar 3-star review plus an assertable one-to-one ortholog?
frames.subject_population: Human disease genes touched by the dog-to-human bridge

scope.measures: This frame measures ClinVar 3-star review reach into canine models via dog orthology, not the canine literature.

sources_not_queried.reason: OMIA is the authority on documented canine Mendelian disease. This frame's answered predicate is ClinVar 3-star pathogenic or likely pathogenic plus an assertable dog ortholog, so OMIA was not queried.
sources_not_queried.close_path: Publish a parallel OMIA-scoped frame over the same subject axis (sniff:frame/human-disease-gene-canine-model/omia). Do not join OMIA into this frame's answered predicate. Narrowness is the measurement.

frames.question: Does OMIA document a canine Mendelian disease-gene for this human disease gene?
frames.subject_population: Human disease genes touched by the dog-to-human bridge

scope.measures: This frame measures OMIA's documented canine Mendelian disease-gene reach into the same human-disease-gene universe. It is not ClinVar, and it is not a combined census.

sources_not_queried.reason: This frame measures OMIA. ClinVar 3-star reach is a different frame over the same axis.
sources_not_queried.close_path: Stack with sniff:frame/human-disease-gene-canine-model. Do not join ClinVar into this answered predicate.

frames.question: Does any scoped source document a canine model foundation for this human disease gene?
frames.subject_population: Human disease genes touched by the dog-to-human bridge

scope.measures: This frame stacks scoped source-frames over one subject axis. A cell is answered when any constituent is lit, and dark when every constituent of this stack is dark. dark_in_all_frames is scoped to the named constituents, not to the world. Causes stay on the constituents.

protocols.match_criteria: A cell is answered when the human gene has a 3-star ClinVar P/LP anchor AND an assertable dog ortholog (Compara one2one, or the OrthoDB/OMA moderate ladder for reachability). Dark causes per the precedence funnel; below_bar is denominated by the named dial.

positive_controls.subject: ENSEMBL:ENSG00000141510
positive_controls.basis: TP53: OMIA:000620-9615 (histiocytic sarcoma), canine, listed by OMIA among the genes associated with this phene, independent of this pipeline. Weaker anchor than F8 and VWF: OMIA records this phene as multifactorial with no key variant known, and removed its candidate variant from the table of likely causal variants. Retained as a control on the recorded association, not on a causal variant.

positive_controls.subject: ENSEMBL:ENSG00000185010
positive_controls.basis: F8: OMIA:000437-9615 (hemophilia A), canine, documented independent of this pipeline

positive_controls.subject: ENSEMBL:ENSG00000110799
positive_controls.basis: VWF: OMIA:001057-9615 (von Willebrand disease), canine, documented independent of this pipeline

darkness_controls.subject: ENSEMBL:ENSG00000187191
darkness_controls.basis: DAZ3: the DAZ cluster arose by transposition and amplification of autosomal DAZL onto the primate Y chromosome (Saxena et al. 1996, PMID:8896558); no non-primate genome, the dog included, carries a DAZ gene, so no ortholog exists for the assay to observe

darkness_controls.subject: ENSEMBL:ENSG00000112592
darkness_controls.basis: TBP: ClinVar holds 28 germline pathogenic or likely pathogenic records for TBP (spinocerebellar ataxia 17) and none reviewed by an expert panel (E-utilities esearch, read 2026-09-04 UTC), so a human anchor exists and sits under the three-star bar

darkness_controls.subject: ENSEMBL:ENSG00000121410
darkness_controls.basis: A1BG: ClinVar holds no germline pathogenic or likely pathogenic record for A1BG (E-utilities esearch, read 2026-09-04 UTC) while a one-to-one dog ortholog exists, so the question cannot be asked of this gene from a human anchor

protocols.match_criteria: A cell is answered when a recorded OMIA canine (NCBI taxon 9615) disease-gene identifier exists for this human gene symbol, mapped onto the shared subject axis. Dark cells are no_disease_anchor under OMIA: no such record. This frame does not assign below_bar.

darkness_controls.basis: A1BG: no OMIA canine phene lists this gene (OMIA phene table, read directly 2026-09-04) while a one-to-one dog ortholog exists

protocols.match_criteria: A cell is answered when ANY constituent frame is answered (lit in at least one scoped source). A cell is dark when EVERY constituent is dark. Causes are not assigned here; they remain on the constituents. Constituents must share one subject axis.

populations.selection: Every human gene touched by the dog-to-human bridge: ClinVar P/LP disease-gene atoms (3-star anchors kept, below-expert-bar signal retained as below_bar) joined to the dog orthology ladder; the human-gene selection funnel total (the human-gene selection funnel total).
Dog genes with ortholog_status=one2one in the Ensembl Compara one-to-one set; the moderate OrthoDB/OMA ladder used for reachability is stated in match_criteria, not double-counted here.
